description: Unit tests for QuicBufferedPacketStore class in the QUIC protocol implementation, testing packet buffering, delivery, expiration, and handling of connection limits.

classes.name: QuicBufferedPacketStoreVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class for handling expired packet queues in the store.

classes.name: QuicBufferedPacketStoreTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing QuicBufferedPacketStore functionalities.

methods.name: OnExpiredPackets
methods.description: Callback invoked when packets expire, storing the expired packet queue.

methods.name: SimpleEnqueueAndDeliverPacket
methods.description: Test enqueuing a packet and then delivering it, verifying contents and state.

methods.name: DifferentPacketAddressOnOneConnection
methods.description: Test handling of packets with different peer addresses on the same connection.

methods.name: EnqueueAndDeliverMultiplePacketsOnMultipleConnections
methods.description: Test buffering and delivery of multiple packets across multiple connections.

methods.name: FailToBufferTooManyPacketsOnExistingConnection
methods.description: Test store limits on number of packets buffered per connection.

methods.name: ReachNonChloConnectionUpperLimit
methods.description: Test limit on number of connections without CHLO buffered.

methods.name: FullStoreFailToBufferDataPacketOnNewConnection
methods.description: Test behavior when store is full and new connection data packets arrive.

methods.name: EnqueueChloOnTooManyDifferentConnections
methods.description: Test buffering CHLOs on multiple connections up to store limit.

methods.name: PacketQueueExpiredBeforeDelivery
methods.description: Test expiration of long-staying connection packet queues.

methods.name: SimpleDiscardPackets
methods.description: Test discarding buffered packets for a connection.

methods.name: DiscardWithCHLOs
methods.description: Test discarding packets including CHLOs for a connection.

methods.name: MultipleDiscardPackets
methods.description: Test discarding packets for multiple connections.

methods.name: DiscardPacketsEmpty
methods.description: Test discarding packets for a non-existent connection (no effect).

methods.name: IngestPacketForTlsChloExtraction
methods.description: Test processing of packets for TLS CHLO extraction, including multi-packet CHLOs.

methods.name: DeliverInitialPacketsFirst
methods.description: Test prioritization of initial packets during delivery.
